blocks.raw: You can integrate Capillary with Shopify and activate a loyalty program for your website.
blocks.text: You can integrate Capillary with Shopify and activate a loyalty program for your website.

blocks.raw: Navigate to [Capillary Shopify integration](https://apps.shopify.com/capillary-crm-integration) to integrate the Capillary plugin into Shopify.
blocks.text: Navigate to Capillary Shopify integration to integrate the Capillary plugin into Shopify.

blocks.raw: The purpose of this document is to give a detailed overview of all Shopify user flows and how to navigate the application.
blocks.text: The purpose of this document is to give a detailed overview of all Shopify user flows and how to navigate the application.

blocks.raw: The scope of this document is to cover the Shopify user flows relating to Phase 1.1.
blocks.text: The scope of this document is to cover the Shopify user flows relating to Phase 1.1.

blocks.raw:
To install the Shopify app publicly, you must publish the app in the Shopify App Marketplace.
Alternatively, you can install the app in development stores from the Shopify Partner account.
blocks.text:
To install the Shopify app publicly, you must publish the app in the Shopify App Marketplace.
Alternatively, you can install the app in development stores from the Shopify Partner account.

blocks.raw: ### Create a public app in Shopify Partner
blocks.text: Create a public app in Shopify Partner

blocks.raw:
1. Log in to the Shopify Partner account.
2. Go to **Apps** from the left sidebar.
3. Click **Create app**.
4. Choose **Public app**.
5. Add the following details:

   * App name
   * App URL
     (Server domain URL)
   * Allowed redirection URL
     (`app_url/authenticate`)
6. Create the app.

blocks.raw: ### Install the app in a Shopify store
blocks.text: Install the app in a Shopify store

blocks.raw:
1. Go to **Apps** in the Partner dashboard.
2. Select the created app.
3. Click **Select store**.
4. Choose a development store from the list.
5. Install the app.
blocks.text: Go to Apps in the Partner dashboard.Select the created app.Click Select store.Choose a development store from the list.Install the app.

3. Provide authentication details:

   * Base URL of the API (contact Capillary team)
4. Submit the configuration.
